protocol_intro: A few quiet rituals before and after your session decide how evenly your shade develops — and how gracefully it leaves.
footer_tagline: Tel Aviv's original bespoke spray tanning Master. Twenty years of experience. Never orange. Fades beautifully.
philo_p1: Everyone's skin has its own natural shade— an undertone of olive, rose, or gold that decides how color will develop on it. After two decades of customising tans daily, I can predict your perfect spraytan shade before applying a single drop of solution. The result is a shade that suits only you and your desired tan. No two spray tans are the same.
ritual_eyebrow: The Ritual · from door to glow
philo_p2: My solutions are imported, FDA approved, and blended by hand in my studio. I also carry PETA safe products, free of scents, paraben free, and the option to contour.  My spraytan technique is refined after tanning thousands of brides, editorial shoots, and celebrities— whether you'd like to look like you spent the summer in Ibiza or just don't want to look like you're white as a ghost with just a hint of color, I've got you covered!
quote_text: “Twenty years, hundreds of brides, and not a single *orange* one.”
ritual3_body: Hand-applied contour in minutes. Develops in just one hour; lasts beautifully for up to ten days.
ritual2_body: Your solution is mixed by hand from twelve base tones — a recipe we note, keep, and repeat.
area_p1: The studio sits on Dizengoff 218, in the heart of Tel Aviv, a few minutes from Kikar Rabin and the Old North. Clients come from across the city and beyond — Ramat Aviv, Jaffa, Givatayim, Ramat Gan and Herzliya — for a spray tan that is mixed by hand rather than sprayed from a bottle. Brides book weeks ahead of the chuppah; everyone else books the morning of the flight.
ritual1_body: Ten minutes on your undertone, your occasion, and how deep you want to go.
area_p2: If you can't come to my spraytan studio on Dizengoff, the tan can come to you: at-home and hotel spray tanning is available across Tel Aviv and, by arrangement, anywhere in Israel — for bridal parties, photo shoots, and anyone who would rather glow at home.

pro4_body: Keep showers short and lukewarm, and give pools and long sea swims a few days' grace. Cared for this way, your glow fades slowly, evenly, and entirely on its own terms.
hero_sub: Get a customized hand-applied airbrush spraytan that I mix specifically to your undertone, results never fake looking. Fades beautifully. Worn by brides, models, and anyone who refuses to look orange. From bronze to chocolate brown, I'll get you the exact shade you are dreaming of!
svc5_desc: Camera-perfect color for shoots, stage, and screen. Perfect for bridal parties and hotel visits. Trusted by celebrities and brides across Tel Aviv and all over Israel. On location by arrangement for anyone who wants to be tanned but doesn't want to travel.
pro3_body: This is when your shade develops. No water, no sweat, no tight straps. When the time is up, rinse in lukewarm water without soap and pat, never rub, yourself dry. The outcome will be the best tan you dreamed of ❤️
svc4_desc: Lifted, tinted lashes that help you wake up in the morning looking perfect— no mascara, no maintenance, six weeks of ease. (Results vary 6-8 weeks on average)
pro2_body: Arrive with bare skin — no moisturizer, deodorant, perfume, or makeup. Bring loose, dark clothing and flip flops. The solution needs room to breathe; so do you.
svc3_desc: Rapid contour color for the dinner, the date, the flight tonight. In and out — glowing — before your espresso cools. Takes only 1 hour to develop to get that perfect glow for a same day event!
pro1_body: Complete any waxing or shaving now, so pores can settle. If you can, exfoliate gently the day before — polished skin takes retains color better. Then leave your skin alone: no oils, no self-tanner remnants, nothing on your skin.
svc2_desc: A bridal trial session minimum 4 weeks before the wedding date, just on your legs, or for anyone who just wants a darker tone to create sexier legs.
